release_notes_id: Penambahan kotak edit input volume manual di sebelah slider dengan efek fading bertahap, sinkronisasi pembaca layar untuk slider dan kotak edit volume, serta penyempurnaan akurasi transisi fading.
release_notes_en: Added a manual volume edit field next to the volume slider with smooth fading transitions, aligned screen reader values between the slider and edit field, and improved fading transition timing accuracy.
